Codex 0.157.1 — third-party notices and source availability

Codex source revision: 36650394c5b38c2990ccf2a3457165ca3e9d9726
Upstream: https://github.com/openai/codex/tree/36650394c5b38c2990ccf2a3457165ca3e9d9726
The original Codex LICENSE and NOTICE are beside this file.

THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.zip contains collected original third-party notices, package
metadata, source headers and standard license terms. THIRD-PARTY.json records
package versions, immutable source references and SHA-256 hashes. Its inventory
is conservative and includes packages for other targets and development.

THIRD-PARTY-SOURCES.zip contains unmodified source archives for all MPL components
in that inventory: option-ext 0.2.0, the Symphonia 0.6.0 family, termina 0.3.3
(included conservatively) and nucleo/nucleo-matcher at
4253de9faabb4e5c6d81d946a5e35a90f87347ee. Covered source is available under its
original MPL-2.0 terms. The full MPL text is in licenses/MPL-2.0.txt within that
archive and at https://www.mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/. Fort does not restrict your rights
to this covered source. Registry archives match the pinned Cargo.lock checksums;
the source manifest identifies their original download locations and every file.

No download or account is needed to obtain these source copies: the two archives
and this notice ship together in Fort.app/Contents/Helpers/FortHost.app/Contents/
Resources/CodexLicenses/. In Finder, use Show Package Contents on Fort.app, then on
the nested FortHost.app, and copy the archives from Resources/CodexLicenses. The
archives also include original sources for the three MIT declaration-only cases
described in THIRD-PARTY.json. Preserve their original declarations and attribution.

These licenses concern the supplied software, not permission to access an account
or a hosted service. This bundle makes no provider sign-in or terms agreement.
